metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Baby Reindeer
metas.description: The story follows Donny's warped relationship with a female stalker and the impact it has on him as he is ultimately forced to face a deep, dark buried trauma.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2023 · Beckham
metas.description: With never-before-seen footage, this docuseries follows David Beckham's meteoric rise from humble beginnings to global football stardom.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · House of Guinness
metas.description: Follows the aftermath of the death of brewery mogul, Sir Benjamin Guinness, and the profound impact of his will on the fate of his four adult children: Arthur, Edward, Anne and Ben.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2022 · This Is Going to Hurt
metas.description: Set on Labour Ward with all its hilarity and heart-lifting highs but also its gut-wrenching lows, the show delivers a brutally honest depiction of life as a junior doctor on the wards, and the toll the job can take back home.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · The Playlist
metas.description: How Swedish tech entrepreneur Daniel Ek and business partner Martin Lorentzon revolutionized the music industry through free and legal music streaming when they launched Spotify.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2024 · Mr Bates vs. The Post Office
metas.description: One of the greatest miscarriages of justice in British legal history where hundreds of innocent sub-postmasters and postmistresses were wrongly accused of theft, fraud and false accounting due to a defective IT system.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · The Long Shadow
metas.description: Dramatizing one of the most infamously notorious serial killer cases, the hunt for the Yorkshire Ripper, between 1975 and 1981. The search involved over a thousand officers and changed the way the British police worked forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2022 · The Thief, His Wife and the Canoe
metas.description: Four-part drama based on the extraordinary story of how prison officer John Darwin faked his own death to claim life insurance and avoid bankruptcy - unbeknownst to his two sons.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Robbie Williams
metas.description: After 25 years of his record-breaking solo career, Robbie looks back on his younger self and reflects on a lifetime spent in the spotlight.
